'''Cat Dancer''' is the war horse ridden by [[al'Lan Mandragoran]] during the [[Aiel War]].{{ref/book|0|1}}

==Appearance==
Cat Dancer is a bay stallion.{{ref/book|0|1}}

==History==
[[File:Canluum.jpg|200px|thumb|left|Lan leading Cat Dancer into Canluum.]]
Cat Dancer carried Lan Mandragoran near [[Tar Valon]] in the last days of the Aiel War.{{ref/book|0|1}} He is also with Lan when the [[Malkieri]] and his company scout for [[Aiel]] near [[Kinslayer's Dagger]].{{ref/book|0|12}} Cat Dancer carried Lan to [[Canluum]] in [[Kandor]].{{ref/book|0|15}} As a trained war horse, Cat Dancer helps Lan, [[Moiraine Damodred]], [[Bukama Marenellin]], and [[Ryne Venamar]] defend against bandits on their way the [[Chachin]].{{ref/book|0|21}} As soon as the party arrives in Chachin, Lan gallops away to the [[Aesdaishar Palace]].{{ref/book|0|22}}
